description: Every adult with obesity (BMI >= 30) in the market, before any comorbidity restriction. The default population when no clinical subgroup is chosen, and the denominator every subgroup share below is a share of.
source: WHO Global Health Observatory, adult obesity prevalence, age-standardised, both sexes (NCD_BMI_30A). Published per country; see who_country_indicators.csv.

description: Adults with obesity who also have diagnosed type 2 diabetes. The largest single comorbid subgroup, and the one where incident diabetes cannot be avoided because these patients already have it.
source: Derived from WHO Global Health Observatory indicators by the analyst, in who_derived_obesity_subgroups_and_eligibility.csv: the country's adult obesity prevalence gives the prevalent obese population, and each clinical subgroup is a share of that population read off the corresponding WHO comorbidity indicator. The share is an observation-anchored derivation, not a directly published figure. These subgroups OVERLAP: across the ten source countries their shares sum to roughly 1.5x the obese population, because a patient with both diabetes and hypertension appears in two of them. They are therefore alternative eligibility definitions to be compared, never components of a total to be added.
